bienvenida.title: ¡Hi, {nick}! 👋 So glad to have you here!

pack-info.paginas_bloqueadas: There are {count, number} more images in this pack

dialogo_descargar.mensaje: Log in with your email and password, or sign up, to remove the censorship, save, download or purchase this pack.

toast.like_quitado: You no longer like this pack
toast.error: The action could not be completed, please try again
toast.descarga_no_disponible: The download for this pack is not available yet

buy.nota: Secure payment with PayPal. Once completed, the pack will be available in “My purchases”.
buy.error_pago: We could not process the payment. Please try again in a few seconds, and check “My purchases” before paying again.

gracias.mensaje: The pack is yours. Here is what you get:
gracias.ventaja_completo: Access to every image in the pack, including the paid ones.
gracias.ventaja_descarga: Download the full pack as a ZIP.
gracias.ventaja_mis_compras: The pack stays in “My purchases” so you can see it anytime.

favoritos.vacio: You haven’t saved any packs yet. Tap a pack’s star to save it here.

mis_compras.vacio: You haven’t bought any packs yet.

participa.descripcion: Packs up for vote for upcoming releases.
participa.vacio: There are no open votes right now.
participa.sin_packs: There are no packs in this vote yet.
participa.login_mensaje: You need an account to vote for the pack you want to see first. Log in or create one for free.
participa.verificar_mensaje: You need to verify your email to vote. You can do it from your account.
participa.quitar_voto: Click again to remove your vote
participa.error_voto: Your vote could not be recorded

canjear.descripcion: Have a coupon? Enter it here and redeem it for its pack, which will be saved to your account.
canjear.label: Coupon code
canjear.exito: The pack {pack} is now on your account.

error.invalido: The coupon is not valid. Check that it is typed correctly.
error.usado: This coupon has already been redeemed.
error.ya_tienes: You already own this pack: the coupon was not used and you can give it away.
error.demasiados_intentos: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
error.servidor: The coupon could not be redeemed. Please try again.

dialogo.mensaje: To redeem your coupon and keep the pack on your account you need to log in. No account yet? Create one for free: your coupon will be waiting for you.

soporte.descripcion: Tell us what happened and we will reply by email. You can also follow the ticket from "My tickets".

categoria.cuenta: I can't log in to my account

soporte.asunto_placeholder: Sum up the problem in one sentence
soporte.mensaje_placeholder: Explain what happened, what you expected and, if relevant, when you made the purchase.
soporte.email_ayuda: We'll write to this email. Use your account's email if you remember it.
soporte.anonimo_aviso: Without logging in you can only report problems accessing your account. For anything else, <login>log in</login>.
soporte.exito: We created ticket {code}. We sent you an email with a link to follow it; we'll let you know when we reply.
soporte.reportar_compra: Problems with a purchase? Report it

error.asunto: The subject must be 3 to 150 characters long.
error.mensaje: The message must be 10 to 4000 characters long.
error.requiere_sesion: Log in to report this kind of problem.
error.cerrado: This ticket is closed. If you need help, open a new one.
error.demasiados_intentos: You sent too many messages. Wait a while and try again.
error.servidor: Couldn't send it. Please try again.

ticket.resuelto_aviso: This ticket is resolved. If the problem persists, reply and we'll reopen it.
ticket.cerrado_aviso: This ticket is closed. If you need help, open a new one.
ticket.no_encontrado_desc: The ticket doesn't exist or you don't have access. If you opened it without logging in, use the link in the email we sent you.

lista.vacio: You have no tickets. If something isn't working, let us know.

errores.reportar: Think this is a mistake? Report it

not_found.mensaje: The link may be mistyped, the pack may no longer be available or the page may have moved.

error.mensaje: We had a problem loading this page. Try again; if it keeps failing, let us know.
